recipes.title: Taco Chicken Potato Bowls with Pico de Gallo

items.i: each onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, ground cumin and dried oregano
boneless, skinless chicken breast, diced large
each onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, ground cumin and dried oregano
avocado or olive oil (1 for the marinade, 1 for cooking)
lime, zested, plus about 1 tsp juice
chipotle hot sauce (e.g. Cholula Chipotle), to taste

steps: Toss the diced potatoes with the spices, chilli, oil, salt and pepper.
In the same bowl, toss the diced chicken with the same spices, chilli flakes, 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper.
Mix the tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, coriander and lime juice with a pinch of salt. Refrigerate.
Mix the Greek yogurt, coriander, lime zest and juice and the chipotle sauce. Refrigerate (keeps a week).
Air fry the potatoes at 200°C / 390°F for 18–24 minutes until soft and golden (or roast in the oven).
Sear the chicken in batches in a hot oiled pan, leaving it 2 minutes to crust, then 5–6 minutes total until cooked through.
Per container: 150 g potatoes, 170 g chicken with juices. Add 80 g pico and 40 g sauce when serving (store them separately). Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
recipes.notes: Amounts and per-container nutrition (440 g: 438 cal, 46 g protein, 24 g carbs, 15 g fat) are from the creator. Keep the pico and sauce in separate containers and add after reheating.
